sections.title: About Taxdown
texts: TaxDown helps people file their income tax return easily, from their phone. In Spain it has already filed more than 1.3 million returns.
To attract and retain talent, its team has an incentive plan that must be kept up to date, together with the shareholder register.

sections.title: Why they chose Sttok
texts: 1. Ease of use of the platform.

uses.title: An efficient incentive plan
uses.text: Units, vesting and value for each beneficiary, without spreadsheets.

uses.title: Each beneficiary, in their portal
uses.text: They see their units, their schedule and their documents.

uses.title: The shareholder register, up to date
uses.text: Shareholders and incentives in the same place.
